messages.author: 839dfa09184985a5
messages.subject: Merging Master to other branch
parts:
Hi all,

Is there an easy way to merge master to another branch?

I'm trying to make sure that fvar will work with the new refactoring of the math functions. When I try 'git merge master' when I'm in fvar, it gives a bunch of conflicts. Is there a way to set it to automatically take the master as being right except for the fvar files that obviously wouldn't be in master?


Thanks,
Peter

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Merging Master to other branch
parts:
On Wednesday, April 10, 2013 2:21:07 PM UTC-4, Peter Li wrote:
Is there an easy way to merge master to another branch?

I'm trying to make sure that fvar will work with the new refactoring of the math functions. When I try 'git merge master' when I'm in fvar, it gives a bunch of conflicts. Is there a way to set it to automatically take the master as being right except for the fvar files that obviously wouldn't be in master?

Yes,

git checkout fvar
git merge master -s theirs

But I don't know if that is really a good idea. If there are conflicts, they should probably be investigated individually and fixed rather than using an automatic merge strategy.

Ben
